purpose: causal controls: each removes exactly one feature from a diverging scenario and must restore graded/unrestored/exit 1. Written before the controls were run.

scenarios.axis: control for fence-heading-move: the same 25 lines born plainly under ## Round 1, no fence and no quoted ## heading

contract_rows: SCORE.md	A-corr	NOTES.md:1	exempt=## Axes@NOTES.md:2	fixture
fixture.c1: SCORE.md: [# score, ## Axes, h0..h4, ## Round 1, d0..d4, f0..f24]
fixture.c2: f0..f24 moved into the ## Axes head (diff: 6 deletions, no event)
fixture.c3: f0..f24 dropped from the head and replaced by 30 regrow lines (diff: 25 deletions)

intended.reason: same as fence-heading-move's intent: dated text dropped under the head is graded

scenarios.why: origin(f_i) = {'## Round 1'} (no quoted heading anywhere), so :475 grades the drop; this isolates the fenced heading as the only cause of the fence-heading-move divergence

scenarios.axis: control for star-plus-exempt-row: the identical rewrite under a contract holding only the * row

contract_rows: SCORE.md	A-corr	NOTES.md:1	*	whole-file row only
fixture.c1: SCORE.md: [# score, ## Axes, 25 orig lines, ## Round 1, d0..d2]
fixture.c2: the 25 ## Axes lines rewritten in place with distinct text (orig* -> new*)

intended.reason: a `*` row grades every line, so this is the reading the whole-file row asks for

scenarios.why: file_regions() returns no titles and no prefixes for a `*` row, so nothing is skipped and nothing is exempt: graded=25. This isolates the second exempt row as the only cause of the star-plus-exempt-row divergence
